name: Sushi Bar Broiled Freshwater Eel (Unagi over White Rice, Light Tare)
whyItWorks: Freshwater eel steamed and broiled until meltingly tender with a delicate sweet soy glaze. High in vitamin A, vitamin E, and bioavailable protein; very soft on intestinal mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Unagi Nigiri with light sweet tare sauce on top, NO wasabi, NO sesame seeds.'
